parameters.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fs.frappe_doc_name) AS invoices, SUM(fs.total_amount) AS total_sales, SUM(fs.margin_amount) AS total_margin FROM fact_sales fs JOIN dim_date d ON fs.date_key = d.date_key WHERE fs.company_id = {{$json.company_id}} AND d.full_date BETWEEN '{{$json.start_date}}' AND '{{$json.end_date}}';

SELECT di.item_name, SUM(fs.quantity) AS qty_sold, SUM(fs.total_amount) AS total_sales FROM fact_sales fs JOIN dim_date d ON fs.date_key = d.date_key JOIN dim_item di ON fs.item_key = di.item_key WHERE fs.company_id = {{$('Entrada de la Herramienta').item.json.company_id}} AND d.full_date BETWEEN '{{$('Entrada de la Herramienta').item.json.start_date}}' AND '{{$('Entrada de la Herramienta').item.json.end_date}}' GROUP BY di.item_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 5;
